jobs.prompt:
Create ONE original horror game cover. Use case: stylized-concept. Input image is a REFERENCE for the approved VHS texture, flashlight exposure and title design, not an edit target. Make a NEW encounter with one vaguely humanoid BLACK SHADOW, extremely tall and slender, an ambiguous almost person-shaped absence. Small long featureless head, narrow sloping shoulders, unusually long arms and legs. The entity is opaque soot-black, darker than surrounding room, with softly irregular charcoal edges. NO visible eyes, no white face, no exposed pale skin, no teeth, no suit or tie, no recognizable existing character. No monster anatomy showcase; conceal detail. A disturbing still presence rather than an attack pose. It must read as a three-dimensional standing shadow person, not a shadow cast on the wall. Do not copy the pale multi-armed creature from the reference.
Maintain the reference's low-definition painted photographic-composite aesthetic; muted dirty green/blue/brown, imperfect focus, simplified details, no glossy 3D rendering, no hyperreal skin or crisp cinematic photography. Local flashlight/direct-camera-flash illumination: a nearby piece of wall/door/bedding catches harsh light with slight highlight clipping; light falls off rapidly. A dim patch of lit background separates the shadow's narrow silhouette. The black entity absorbs light and never becomes gray fully lit flesh. No theatrical rim lighting, no volumetric beams or decorative mist.
Strong analog VHS: fine scanlines, noisy crushed blacks, chroma crawl, slight red/cyan edge bleed, subtle motion ghosting, one narrow horizontal tracking disturbance and bottom head-switching noise. Keep silhouette and title readable through noise. White PLAY indicator top left, 00:13:08 top right. Exact large Chinese title “心里有鬼” and smaller spaced “YOUR OWN GHOST”, pale tape-damaged serif letters like reference. No other text. No gore. One coherent scene, not a grid or montage.
FORMAT: 2:3 portrait composition, 1024×1536. Entity in upper 75%, title across bottom darkness, vertical height emphasized.
SCENE: A narrow doorway into a dark domestic room. A terribly thin black humanoid is standing half concealed behind the open door, head near the lintel tilted sideways, one long arm hanging well below its knees. Low handheld viewpoint from inside the room. Flashlight burns a patch on the near doorframe and wall behind the entity; the shape itself stays almost pure black. Its shoulder and head lean just far enough around the door to suggest watching. Intimate, quiet, not a jump-scare hand reaching at camera.
